memory_candidates.insight: Lean's linter.style.longFile baseline must EQUAL the file's round-up to the next hundred, not a forward-looking ceiling. A plan that pre-authorizes raising the baseline once to its anticipated final value will produce a build warning; the baseline has to be bumped per phase as the file grows.

In this repository, any .lean edit that changes line counts stales typst/generated/status.typ and the pre-commit typst-sync gate refuses the commit. The sanctioned remedy is 'bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix' plus staging that file; the hook's bypass is only for drift caused by a foreign writer. Plan phase file lists should anticipate this third file.

An anchor hypothesis on a lift lemma can be eliminable rather than constructible: when the lemma already assumes a pairwise-compatible pin family, a McShane extension through those pins returns a register whose value at 0 witnesses the anchor, so the anchor slot is redundant and the stronger lemma drops it.
